MapLibre GL JS 5.12.0 browser distribution, unmodified, from:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@5.12.0/dist/maplibre-gl.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@5.12.0/dist/maplibre-gl.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/maplibre-gl@5.12.0/LICENSE.txt

Used only by the Atelier map study. BSD license retained in maplibre-LICENSE.txt.
The basemap uses OpenFreeMap's Liberty style and its OpenStreetMap attribution.
Tiles, sprites and fonts require a network connection; sample results remain available without them.
